description: IT service desk: The collection digitisation pipeline stopped processing overnight; new scans are queuing but not being ingested into the DAM. Conservation cannot proceed with Phase 2 uploads until it is restored. Reported to the digital team; investigating.

IT service desk: Both point-of-sale terminals at the main ticket desk are failing to connect to the payment processor, so card ticket sales are down. Staff are taking cash only. Needs urgent attention before opening. Reported to the digital team; investigating.

IT service desk: Staff across the museum are unable to send or receive mail on kunstmuseum.at accounts; the mail server is returning connection timeouts. Board correspondence is affected. Reported to the digital team; investigating.

IT service desk: The badge readers at the Burgring staff entrance are denying valid cards, leaving staff unable to enter without manual sign-in at reception. Access control system needs checking. Reported to the digital team; investigating.
short_description: Badge access failing at staff entrance
